CustomField.label: Integration Product Line
CustomField.description: Product2.Product_Line__c as text (via PricebookEntry, the only path formulas on this object can take to the product), so record-triggered Flows can filter Opportunity Products by product line. Used by the Salesforce -> Jira integration (Scenario 2, cancellation) to decide which product lines a churned Opportunity carries. The older Product_Line__c formula on this object is CPQ-specific and blank for Revenue Cloud lines.
